system.sensesNotes: Blindsight 60 ft through water and living vegetation
system.tactics: The Kelpbound Colossus waits motionless in a kelp forest or around a wreck, then uses Kelp Snare to separate swimmers from their boats. It grapples one target while its second slam controls the rescue attempt. It retreats into dense vegetation when exposed to fire and returns once the threat is gone.
system.attacksNotes:
Kelp Slam [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft

  • Margin 1:: 16 damage (10 + 6 Str)
  • Margin 2: 16 damage, DR halved (round up); target is Grappled

Multiattack [Combat]: The Kelpbound Colossus makes two Kelp Slam ### Attacks against one or two targets. Shared Attribute Roll (Agil 4): Roll Agility once and apply it to both ### Attacks. Roll Melee Combat separately for each attack.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: False Appearance: While motionless in a kelp forest, mangrove channel, or wreck covered in vegetation, the Kelpbound Colossus is indistinguishable from the surrounding growth. A creature that succeeds on a Hard Perception check notices movement or an unnatural shape before it ### Attacks. Kelp Snare (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: Kelp erupts in a 20-foot square within 60 feet. Creatures in the area make Reflex saves opposed by the Colossus's Might 5 + Melee Combat 6. On a loss, a creature becomes Restrained until it succeeds on a Hard Athletics or Acrobatics check as a [Combat] action. The area is Difficult Terrain for 1 minute. Tide-Fed Renewal: At the start of its turn while submerged in natural water, the Kelpbound Colossus regains 4 HP. This does not function while it is on fire or while it has taken fire damage since the end of its last turn. Plant Resilience: The Kelpbound Colossus is immune to Blinded, Deafened, and Exhaustion. It does not need air, food, or sleep. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
